style: Premium miniature stop-motion set photography in the manner of a Laika or Wes Anderson miniature set shot for a high-end commercial: handcrafted matte clay, wool felt, painted wood and small brushed-brass details; tactile real-world miniature textures; macro lens with shallow depth of field (about f/4); subtle film grain. Refined, calm, elegant and adult; never childish, never cartoonish, no glossy plastic, no neon.
light: Soft studio key light from the upper left, warm bounce fill, gentle soft shadows; the lighting direction is identical across the whole series.
palette: warm cream #F1ECE2 walls and floors, cobalt blue #2B3BCF for his things, soft coral #F08C8C for her things, lilac #B8B2EA accents, ink #232024 details, brushed brass #B08D57 hardware.
characters: The people are premium 3D animated characters with adult proportions (about 7 heads tall), a fashion-editorial look like a high-end Apple or IKEA motion commercial, matte clay-like skin with subtle subsurface scattering, natural-sized eyes (never oversized), real fabric materials, calm and graceful body language.
groom: the groom: a Korean man about 30, short neat black hair with a soft side part, black rectangular glasses, slim build, calm friendly smile
bride: the bride: a Korean woman about 30, chin-length black bob with see-through bangs, small pearl earrings, gentle smile

daily.groom: a cobalt-navy fine-knit sweater over a white collared shirt, light warm grey trousers, brown leather loafers
daily.bride: a soft coral knit cardigan over a cream blouse, a flowing cream midi skirt, ballet flats

wedding.groom: a black tuxedo with satin lapels and a black bow tie
wedding.bride: a white off-shoulder lace wedding gown, hair tucked with a small pearl pin

casual.groom: a light blue cardigan over a white t-shirt, cream trousers, white sneakers
casual.bride: a white summer dress and a short sheer veil

avoid: text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, chibi proportions, big cartoon eyes, plastic sheen, neon, clutter, extra people

Cross-section of a two-room miniature dollhouse standing on a large cream studio tabletop: we see the front edge of the table, the outer walls and the pitched roof line, so it clearly reads as a miniature set on a table. The left room is his: a tidy study with a cobalt-blue painted wall, a straight-lined walnut desk, a neat shelf of books and a brass desk lamp; the groom sits at the desk writing. The right room is hers: a soft coral wall, curved furniture, many plants in ceramic pots and a hanging vine; the bride waters a plant. A single cream partition wall separates the two rooms. Camera straight-on and slightly elevated, the whole house centered with breathing room; the upper third is calm empty studio backdrop for typography. Daytime.

Macro still life on the cream tabletop: a cobalt ceramic cup of black coffee on the left and a coral ceramic cup of milk on the right, side by side with a small gap, shallow depth of field, calm empty upper third for typography.

Medium-wide shot; he stands in the right half; the left half and the upper third are calm empty cobalt wall for typography.

Her room in the miniature dollhouse (soft coral wall, curved furniture, plants), daytime. A gallery wall of small picture frames with simple abstract paintings, all hanging charmingly crooked; the bride stands on tiptoe adjusting one frame and, amused, tilts it even more. Medium-wide shot; she is in the right third; the left third is calm wall for typography.

Close shot of a neat walnut shelf in his cobalt room: a perfectly aligned row of seven identical cobalt ceramic mugs, all handles facing right, and one coral mug in the middle turned the other way. Shallow depth of field, calm empty upper third for typography. No people.

Miniature street at dusk: the facade of a small apartment building with a grid of warm-lit windows. In every window a small simple dark silhouette figure is turned toward the same direction: toward one coral-lit window on the right where a woman's silhouette sits reading a book, unbothered. Straight-on view, calm empty dusk sky in the upper third for typography.

Macro still life on a walnut desk: two vintage horseshoe magnets lying apart with a clear gap, poles facing each other: the left one cobalt enamel with brushed-brass tips, the right one coral enamel with brushed-brass tips. Shallow depth of field, calm empty upper third for typography.

Seen from his cobalt room through an open doorway: the cobalt-painted door frame fills the left and right foreground edges, softly out of focus. In the middle ground, in her sunlit atelier corner, the bride stands full body head to toe beside a cream dress form draped with a brushed-brass tape measure, holding the end of the tape and looking at it thoughtfully; a small sewing table and rolls of coral fabric; her soft coral room glows behind her. She stands slightly right of center; calm wall area on the upper left for typography.

The miniature dollhouse at night with its roof lifted off and floating slightly above it, revealing two warmly lamp-lit rooms from above; above the house a deep periwinkle night sky with soft stars and two brighter stars close together. Camera looks slightly upward; a large calm sky area for typography. No people visible.
